sections.heading: Research Coordinator Message
sections.content:
Name : Dr. R. B. Gaikwad Qualification: Ph.D.,  M.E. (COMPUTER NETWORKS) Designation: HOD,Comp Dept. Teaching Experience:  15 Years Area of Interest: IOT, Machine Learning Email ID: rama.gaikwad@abmspcoerpune.org
As an Emerging Research Institution in Pune City, APCOER is becoming a unique community of Researchers who are conducting an exciting brand of research. The seed in terms of thought of research is sowed in the mind of faculty and students by various means to cater the need of society through technological solution. The neutering of theresearch process in mind of faculty and student in done by means of participating in all the research activities of SPPU, Pune, UGC, AICTE and Ministries of Sate and Central Govt., who provide funds and awards. The all faculties are actively involved in the BCUD Research Grant Schemes of SPPU Pune. Currently we are having 4 Projects ongoing and 35 are submitted under BCUD Research Grant Schemes, of SPPU Pune.
Our faculty prepare students to break new ground in research and innovation, through scholarly contributions and challenging existing paradigms that will result in the improvement of technology.Our faculty and students are nationally and globally recognized for their valuable contributions to the academic community and technology solution of bottle neck problems. Since last 3 years the students of APCOER are participating Avishkar [A novel inter university research project competition started by His Excellency, the Governor of Maharashtra] and brought the laurel to College by winning Avishkar-2017.
The same HEXACOPETR Project is awarded First Prize at Inter-college Level, University level, State Level [DIPEX-2017], National Level [ANVESH-2017], received the design patent of the same and is appreciated in all the leading Newspapers like Indian Express, Pune Mirror, Sakal and many more. The APCOER teams having project “Implementation of Wearable Defence System for Women’s Security using WSN”was shortlisted for the final round of 6 th CSI InApp National Student Project Awards 2017 is invited for their face-to-face presentation at Trivandrum, Kerala during 22-23 April 2017. The Faculty and students have filled the 4 patents in last 1 year.With a great excellence in academics and innovations, APCOER gives the platform to the student’s myriad opportunities to grow through various academic programs.
The colleges always give prime importance to the activities related to the Research, Innovation, IPR and Ph. D. Work of all stake holders. The research environment of the college is built by participating all the event/ seminars/workshops in nearby area related to technology enchantment and innovation. Our research experts are excited about the possible collaborations that will lead to cutting edge technology enhancement and education for all of us. Our primary mission is to provide resources for research and innovation that will aid in our faculty and students professional as well as personal development. We ensure that through top quality education and research activities, our faculty and students definitely become innovative leaders in their respective research areas.
